hooks.command: jq -n '{hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PreToolUse", additionalContext: "PRE-FLIGHT CONTRACT: Before calling daily, complete ALL 4 steps in order: (1) curl -s http://localhost:8088/healthcheck — verify context engine is up (2) recall(action=list, listType=company) + recall(action=list, listType=session) — enumerate BrainOS memory (3) recall relevant company entries + recent sessions — load stored context (4) THEN call external APIs (Calendar, Gmail, Notion) for freshness delta only. Do not skip or reorder these steps."}}'

echo 'Intel gathered. Now call mcp__brain-os-mcp__remember with type=company, label=<company-name>, and the full intel report as content. This persists the findings to context/companies/ so future sessions build on them.'
echo 'Fit score generated. Call mcp__brain-os-mcp__remember with type=company, label=<company-name>, and the fit score + rationale as content. Append to any existing company file.'
echo 'Prep complete. Call mcp__brain-os-mcp__remember with type=company, label=<company-name>, and the prep notes as content. Append to any existing company file.'
echo 'Apply analysis complete. Call mcp__brain-os-mcp__remember with type=session, label=apply-<company-name>-<date>, and the gap analysis + cover letter as content.'
echo 'Outreach drafted. Call mcp__brain-os-mcp__remember with type=company, label=<company-name>, and the outreach drafts + warm intro paths as content. Append to any existing company file.'
echo 'Story drafted. Call mcp__brain-os-mcp__remember with type=story, label=<theme>, and the full STAR story as content. This adds it to the story library for future interview prep.'
echo 'Diagnosis complete. Call mcp__brain-os-mcp__remember with type=insight, label=diagnosis-<date>, and the pattern findings as content. This builds the recurring-gaps library.'
echo 'Scan complete. Call mcp__brain-os-mcp__remember with type=session, label=scan-<date>, and any high-signal opportunities or patterns found as content.'
